caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard with a bow-front silhouette and four slender, tapered legs. The wood is colored in various shades of brown, with visible grain patterns suggesting a polished finish. The sideboard features symmetrical decorative details outlined in yellow or gold, including oval and diamond shapes on the drawer fronts, sides, and legs. There are three top drawers—one central and two on each side—each with oval brass or gold-colored handles. Below the top drawers, there are three larger cupboard sections, also with brass or gold oval handles, and outlined with decorative inlays. The side panels and legs are adorned with additional elongated oval motifs and lines. The background is plain and off-white, keeping the focus on the sideboard itself.
title: Sideboard
